instruction: BUILD+SHADOW-VERIFY Foundation A (cycle 154, OAAW). Preflight markers FoundationAShadow/AutoWalkOscillate/FastBattleHook, *noDrawMax==2, FreeRandomWalk==0. Config BOTH default.json: AutoLogin=true, AutoWalk=true, FastAutoWalk=false, AutoBattle=true, FastBattle=FALSE(scene needed), ShowExp=true, SpeedBoost=0, AutoWalkDistance=5, AutoWalkDelay=5; readback (FastBattle must be false). Delete stale foundationa-shadow/autobattle/autowalk logs. Build via human-b1diag-go.ps1 (fail->error C + NEEDS_INPUT). Launch, Start once, auto-login, ~180s (oscillate->encounter->auto-battle w/ scene; shadow logs wire-vs-scene per turn). Collect foundationa-shadow+autobattle+autowalk. Run assert-foundationA.ps1 (PASS iff comparableTurns>=8 AND matchRate>=0.90). Confirm 嫄룰린議곗슦 oscillation (target orig+/-3, side flips) + battles occurred. If FAIL, paste first 8 mismatch SHADOW lines; change NO code. No commit. Foundation-A code is READ-ONLY (parse+read scene+log; no block, no send). Never print account/password/security-code. See INSTRUCTION.md.
notes: Foundation A shadow-verify: launcher wire battle parser (EN/BP/BC/BA) ported, running in SHADOW mode (parse + compare-log vs client scene feBObj, NO block, NO send). Goal: prove wire-parse == client scene so auto-battle/escape/fall-escape/heal/show-exp (all currently scene-shortcut, see FEATURE-AUDIT-F0.md) can be switched to the wire engine and fast-battle becomes block-only. BC token stride from Stage1 capture: unit i pos at full-token 2+i*13, hp+5 maxhp+6 status+7 level+4. This build also reverts 嫄룰린議곗슦 to pre-blackscreen fixed-origin oscillation (FreeRandomWalk removed - black-screen closed). Fast-battle checkbox is mutually-exclusive with auto-battle (generalform.cpp) and show-exp is independent (both confirmed in audit).
